# σ-algebras generated by a sequence of functions

**σ-algebras generated by a sequence of functions.** For a sequence of functions
$X_n : \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$, this is the sequence of σ-algebras $\sigma(X_n)$ on $\Omega$, where
$\sigma(X_n)$ consists of the preimages under $X_n$ of Borel subsets of $\mathbb{R}$.
